changes: No substantive changes. ce_approx 1746 kept: NS 867 started in about Oct/Nov 1746, so Mārgaśīrṣa (vadi) of that year falls in about Dec 1746. The plain NS+880 formula would give 1747.
Expanded the notes on the catalogue fields (King, Place) and on the ce calculation.

notes: The colophon is only a date written in the right margin of fol. 72v. No era is named, but 'saṃ' with 867 in a Newari-script manuscript is Nepāla Saṃvat. The catalogue's King (Raṇajit Malla, Bhaktapur, r. c. 1722–1769) and Place (Bhaktapur) do not appear in the quoted colophon. They probably come from the text itself: Raṇajit Malla wrote and staged Newar dramas, and he may be this play's author or patron. They fit the date, but no person or place is recorded from the colophon. CE: NS 867 began in about Oct/Nov 1746, so Mārgaśīrṣa kṛṣṇa 6 falls in about Dec 1746. The plain NS+880 formula would give 1747.
